title: Gifts and paid travel from these seven vendors reported by Board of Education members
question: Did any Board of Education member report a gift or paid travel from one of these vendors, and how close was it to a board item on the vendor’s contracts?
finding: 0 gifts or paid trips from the seven vendors are reported by members while they sat on the Board of Education. 2 more ($3,297, from Bay Area Community Resources) appear on statements that list the Board of Education among several offices, filed by Walton, Shamann while holding a supervisor post; they belong to that office (case walton-bacr-trip-and-vote), not to a school-board vote.
how: Form 700 Schedule D (gifts) and E (travel) rows whose filing department includes the Board of Education and whose source is, after normalising, one of the vendor spellings used above. Seated means a statement filed for the Board of Education alone (no supervisor post) covers the gift date. The nearest board item is the nearest meeting in this pull with an item or attachment on that vendor.
limits: Only gifts the members reported, and only from these seven vendors. Travel paid by a nonprofit for a conference is common and is reportable; the State rule that bars voting turns on the gift limit and the twelve months before a decision.
